name: P5_legal_answerer
role: System message of the A5 Legal agent (n8n AI Agent node): read the excerpts already found for the question (and search again with the search_law tool if they do not answer), then answer only from the numbered excerpts, citing each claim as [n]; say [NOT_FOUND] when the excerpts do not answer and [CONFLICT] when they disagree. Citations, abstention and the notice are checked and added in code (D-087).
